newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to invite bids for two pharmaceutical firms.
newsitem.headline: Poland to invite bids for two pharmaceutical firms.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry will soon invite bids for two pharmaceutical companies Polfa Krakow SA and Polfa Rzeszow SA, deputy treasury minister Leszek Juchniewicz said on Friday.
"We will soon publish an invitation to place bids for Polfas in (the cities of) Reszow and Krakow," Juchniewicz told a news briefing. He said it was too early to give any details.
He confirmed the ministry's plan to sell a total of five pharmacutical firms this year. Other companies to be sold are Polfa Poznan SA, Polfa Tarchomin SA and Polfa Starogard SA.
The companies have been carved out from a communist-era drug-making monopoly.
